Hunched yellow-olive goblin with long sideways ears, long nose, jagged grin, red bandana and a big plain red tunic to the knees, charcoal belt and wraps, light grey jagged dagger raised; no armour, shield or helmet. 36.1% owner area, no brown; reads apart from the Human Fighter and the Skeleton at 1x and x4 in all four owner colours.

chibi-goblin-orc-brute.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:GUARD
chibi-goblin-orc-brute.notes: Broad grey-olive orc with tusks, a spiked dark iron pot helmet, a red sleeveless tunic and a round dented iron shield with a red-painted face and spiked boss (the GOBLIN.md fallback for the owner minimum). 18.4% owner area; the round shield reads apart from the Human Guard's tower shield and the armless Zombie in all four owner colours.

chibi-goblin-orc-warboss.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN
chibi-goblin-orc-warboss.notes: Orc war chief with a dark iron helmet with two cream horns, spiky shoulder plates, a tin megaphone at his shouting mouth, a red cape spread on both sides and a red tunic. 17.8% owner area. Anchor (27, 40), 1 px right of the default, keeps the cape's left edge clear of the seat badge. Reads apart from the Human Captain's banner and the Necromancer's staff.

chibi-goblin-rocket-cart.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT
chibi-goblin-rocket-cart.notes: Bead pulp_wars-6gd.5: the user asked for a low-tech goblin invention, a fireworks rocket rather than a modern missile. A fat red paper rocket with cream stars and a cream paper cone cap, lashed with rope loops onto a rickety charcoal scrap cart with mismatched wheels, a launch stick with a small pale spark at its tail, and one small goblin crew in charcoal with a red bandana crouching apart from the rocket. The two edits removed the orange flame and the brown wooden planks. Reads as a firework at zoom 0.75 and beside the Human Catapult. The anchor moves 2 px right so the rear wheel and tail fin clear the seat badge and HP bar strips.

chibi-goblin-scrap-buggy.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT
chibi-goblin-scrap-buggy.notes: Low wide spiky jalopy with plain red body panels, a spiked light grey iron ram in front, dark iron wheels, a crooked exhaust pipe with a round charcoal soot cloud, and a goggled goblin driver in a red flying cap. 20.3% owner area. Anchor (32, 48), 4 px right of the default, keeps the rear wheel clear of the HP bar and seat badge (the placeholder needed 3 px). Reads apart from the Human Knight and the Vampire in all four owner colours.

chibi-goblin-troll.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-goblin-troll.notes: Sample 3 of 3. Giant hunched stone grey-green troll with moss on the head and shoulders, huge drooping nose, cream tusks, a knobbly light grey stone club on the right shoulder and a huge plain red smock over the belly and knees; charcoal wrist straps, no armour. 32.0% owner area; clearly a giant beside the Human Juggernaut and the Abomination in all four owner colours. Giants are exempt from the HP-bar strip rule.

chibi-goblin-wolf-rider.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER
chibi-goblin-wolf-rider.notes: Small yellow-olive goblin with long sideways ears, red bandana and red tunic riding a big dark slate-grey wolf with open jaws and cream fangs, a big red saddle blanket down the wolf's side, short iron spear. 20.0% owner area; a few red-brown pixels on the rider's ear rim (1.4%) stay out of the mask. Reads apart from the Human rider on a pony and the crouching Ghoul in all four owner colours.
